_meta.title: Set S (docs/EVALUATION.md section 1): catalogue objects ray-cast into real empty frames, evaluated with the merged defaults of f4e311f
_meta.author: P4
_meta.commit: f4e311f (evaluated with the P4 branch's `eval`, which gives sequence rows' speed_mps to the detector; detector code identical to f4e311f)
_meta.how_built: the `inject` / `eval` commands recorded per set below (docs/EVALUATION.md section 3); static sets keep their *.npz in data/S_<bag>/ (gitignored), sequence frames were deleted after their evaluation (208 frames x 1.1 MB per set), their gt.json is kept Sequence sets contain one kind each, so their per_bin_counts are the per-kind bins used in recall_by_range_per_kind.
_meta.protocol: static sets: --repeat 3 emulates persistence, no speed given (the estimator runs; on identical repeated frames it reports 0 m/s from the persistent-tracks cue and 2-5 frames are merged, see notes); sequences: --repeat 1, the rows' speed_mps = 15 m/s given to the detector (summary_given) and withheld (summary_nospeed); objects with n_points 0 (fully occluded by real geometry) are excluded from recall and counted in occluded_gt_skipped
_meta.recall_caveat: sequence recall is per object-frame: the first two steps of every 8-step sequence cannot be confirmed (tracking.confirm_hits = 3), so the ceiling is 6/8 = 75 % for an object that is visible from its first step, and an object that starts beyond ~150 m approaches only 10.5 m within its sequence and stays in the 150-300 m bins; quote the first-detection distances for sequences and the static sets for per-range recall. Objects with n_points 0 (fully occluded by real geometry, mostly placed under the real bed where the per-frame track model extrapolates too low beyond ~80 m, EXPERIMENTS.md section 4 item 3) are excluded and counted in occluded_gt_skipped: 23-108 of the 205-208 object-frames per sequence set, 5-12 of 26-55 per static set
_meta.false_alarm_caveat: fp_* and alarm_* of the static sets are not meaningful: every 10th frame of a moving bag is a new scene 1 s apart and the repeats confirm any corridor structure; the sequence sets reuse one background per 8 frames, so their fp_events are the background structures that the (given or estimated) shift smears or that persist
_meta.machine: 4-core sandbox shared with another agent, load 2-5 during the runs (latency fields noisy)
